name: smwsprites-tweeter-giant-tweeter
title: Tweeter + Giant Tweeter
description:
The masked bird-like creature from SMB2 that hops while walking. Extra bit determines if it'll be a regular or a giant Tweeter.

This sprite was part of mikeyk's SMB2 Updated sprites pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.
